edits.new: The gateway is shared platform: it owns no schema, no topic and no task queue, and it stores no business data. The session store is Redis, provisioned by RWB-PLT-N006-INF; partners reach Recovery through the partner gateway in the DMZ and never through this surface (RWB-PLT-N007-INF). This story (service epic RWB-PLT-EDGE) implements gateway-bff; the partner gateway is delivered by RWB-PLT-N007-INF and is outside this story. The run screen (GET /agent-runs/{id}, showing a proposal, a fallback and the versions behind it) is served through the composite route of this story, with data owner P10. The contact panel of a party (consent state and verification of contact points) is served through the same composite route; its screen identifier, field list and masking belong to the case record view story and the edge contract, and SCR-33 stays with the template stories of the same service.
